🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s, with a missing fingertip has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing." "The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once
